anomalies.description: A black car is violently launched into the air and flips sideways after colliding with a green semi-truck, creating a large dust cloud; the red Toyota Supra is visible nearby but not involved in the impact.; A black car is violently struck by a green semi-truck, launching it into the air with visible dust and debris.
The black car remains airborne, rotating mid-air after being hit, passing over a green container and near a white trailer before descending.

A black muscle car (Dodge Charger) is violently struck by a large industrial pipe, causing it to lift off the ground, rotate mid-air, and flip over onto its roof while emitting smoke/dust.; The black car lands on its roof, slides forward, and then rights itself partially while still moving, colliding with or being overtaken by an orange sports car (Mitsubishi Eclipse) that passes closely on the right, generating significant dust and smoke.

A black car collides with an orange sports car (Toyota Supra), resulting in a violent side-impact crash that sends the black car spinning and emitting heavy smoke/dust; the orange car continues forward after impact.

A black classic muscle car skids to a stop, heavily damaged with smoke billowing from the front and driver's side; visible structural deformation and missing body panels indicate a recent high-impact collision.

A man in a black shirt assists or drags an injured, bleeding bald man out of a car; the injured man appears incapacitated and passive, indicating he is a helpless victim being handled by the other man.
